name: expense-review
description: Approve, send for manager approval, or reject one expense line under a written policy with limits in USD, foreign currency converted at the given rates. Alcohol and entertainment are rejected.

input.policy_text:
Travel and expense policy (2026).
1. Meals: up to USD 75 per person per day in standard cities and USD 110 in high-cost cities (London, New York, Tokyo, Zurich, San Francisco).
2. Hotels: up to USD 250 per night in standard cities and USD 400 in high-cost cities.
3. Ground transport (taxi, rideshare, train): up to USD 150 per trip.
4. Alcohol and entertainment are never reimbursable.
5. Any single expense above USD 75 needs an itemised receipt; without one it needs manager approval.
6. Anything above its limit needs manager approval; it is not rejected.
